value.body: Teachers teach school subjects to students and track their learning through classwork, tests and feedback. They work in government, aided and private schools, and the day involves lesson planning, teaching periods, correcting work, meeting parents and school duties.

items.label: Typical entry
items.value: A graduate degree in the subject plus a B.Ed (or D.El.Ed for primary)

items.label: Eligibility tests
items.value: CTET or a State TET for many school posts

value.title: How you get in
value.body: After graduation, a B.Ed (two years) is the usual requirement for secondary teaching, and CTET or a state TET is required for many government and some private school posts. Government school recruitment happens through state or central recruitment exams.

value.title: At a glance
items: Government recruitment is exam-based and timing varies by state.
Common next steps: senior teacher, head of department, coordinator, or principal.
Private-school pay and terms vary widely.
